name: Spider Clan 🕷️
desc:
🕸️ Survive as a SPIDER, team up with your clan, kill enemy creatures, fight other clans to become the biggest & strongest of your clan!

🦂 There are 5 different clans to choose from, but you can become other creatures as well.
